text: It depends on the person and the job, but for me a mix works best. At home you save time on commuting and can concentrate without colleagues interrupting you. On the other hand, it's easy to feel isolated, and some things, like training new staff or brainstorming, simply work better face to face. That's why I think two or three days in the office is a good balance.

tips.en: For me a mix works best states your view straight after “it depends”.
tips.kk: For me a mix works best — «байланысты» дегеннен кейін бірден өз ұстанымыңыз.
tips.ru: For me a mix works best — после «зависит» сразу своя позиция.
tips.example: for me a mix works best

tips.en: Training new staff or brainstorming shows exactly what works better together.
tips.kk: Training new staff or brainstorming — нені бірге істеген дұрыс екені нақты.
tips.ru: Training new staff or brainstorming — что именно лучше делать вместе.

questions.question: Is it better to work from home or in an office?

text: The main advantage is communication. When everyone sits together, people share ideas quickly and managers are easier to approach. But the noise can be a real problem — phone calls, conversations and constant interruptions make it very hard to do focused work. Ideally, an open-plan office should also have a few quiet rooms where people can go when they need to concentrate.

tips.en: The main advantage is and But answer both parts of the question.
tips.kk: The main advantage is … But — сұрақ екі бөлікті, жауап та солай.
tips.ru: The main advantage is … But — вопрос двойной, и ответ тоже.

tips.en: A few quiet rooms is a practical solution at the end.
tips.kk: A few quiet rooms — соңындағы іс жүзіндегі шешім.
tips.ru: A few quiet rooms — практичное решение в конце.

questions.question: What are the advantages and disadvantages of open-plan offices?

text: Mainly because more people now work remotely or for themselves. Working from home every day can get lonely, but renting a private office is too expensive for freelancers. Coworking spaces offer something in between — a desk, fast internet and other people around you, without a long contract. They're also good for networking, since you might end up sitting next to a potential client.

tips.en: Something in between shows coworking fills the gap between home and an office.
tips.kk: Something in between — коворкинг үй мен кеңсенің арасындағы олқылықты толтырады.
tips.ru: Something in between — коворкинг закрывает разрыв между домом и офисом.

tips.en: Good for networking is followed at once by the example of a client.
tips.kk: Good for networking — және бірден клиент мысалы.
tips.ru: Good for networking — и сразу пример с клиентом.

text: More than people usually think. Light, temperature and noise all affect concentration, so a dark, stuffy classroom makes learning harder from the start. The layout matters too. When desks are arranged in rows, students mostly listen, but when they sit in small groups, they discuss and work together more. I'd like schools to have flexible furniture that teachers can move depending on the activity.

tips.en: Light, temperature and noise name three factors in one sentence.
tips.kk: Light, temperature and noise — бір сөйлемде үш фактор.
tips.ru: Light, temperature and noise — три фактора одной фразой.
tips.example: Light, temperature and noise all affect concentration

tips.en: In rows and in small groups show how the layout shapes the lesson.
tips.kk: In rows … in small groups — салыстыру пішіннің сабаққа әсерін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: In rows … in small groups — контраст показывает, как форма влияет на урок.
tips.example: When desks are arranged in rows

text: I think they should, at least in most jobs. When people are expected to answer messages late at night, they never fully switch off, and that leads to exhaustion and lower productivity in the long run. Some countries, like France, have already introduced rules about this. Of course, emergency services and some senior roles are different, but they should be the exception rather than the rule.

tips.en: They never fully switch off explains what is wrong with constant contact.
tips.kk: They never fully switch off — үздіксіз байланыстың неге зиян екенін түсіндіресіз.
tips.ru: They never fully switch off — объясняете, чем плох постоянный контакт.

tips.en: The exception rather than the rule admits special cases without giving up your view.
tips.kk: The exception rather than the rule — ерекше жағдайларды мойындап, ұстанымды сақтайсыз.
tips.ru: The exception rather than the rule — признаёте особые случаи, не теряя позиции.
tips.example: the exception rather than the rule
